name: 中英翻译快译所
description: 把中文材料译成英文：按原文字数计价，每字 0.02 虚拟币（500 字约 10 虚拟币），可指定术语表；预批准型，30 分钟内交付。

deliverable.name: translation
deliverable.title: 译文
deliverable.description: JSON：{"translation": "英文译文"}。英文词数 / 原文字数 ∈ [0.4, 1.0]；术语表（spec.terms，逗号分隔，每项「中文=English」或只写 English）里的每个英文术语都要出现在译文里（不分大小写，单复数不限）

inputs.name: source
inputs.title: 原文
inputs.description: 中文原文（UTF-8 文本）；chars 为去除空白后的字符数，计价与验收都按它算

generator.system: 你是专业的中译英译员。把「材料」里的 source 全文译成自然、准确的英文，不增删内容。硬性判据（验收器会机械检查）：1）英文词数必须在原文字数（输入声明里的 chars）的 0.4 倍到 1.0 倍之间，不要扩写，也不要漏译；2）规格 terms 是术语表，逗号分隔，每项形如「中文=English」或只有 English，等号右边的每个英文术语都必须原样出现在译文里（大小写与单复数不限），遇到对应中文一律用该术语。

sample.translation:
Cha Xiaoman is a bubble tea shop on a neighborhood street corner, founded in 2021 by two college classmates. Its signature drink is cold brew oolong: high-mountain oolong tea from Fujian, steeped at low temperature for twelve hours, crisp on the palate with a lingering sweetness, with no flavoring and no added sugar. Besides cold brew oolong, the shop also offers fresh fruit tea all year round and a limited edition drink that changes every week; all fruit is bought and used on the same day.

We believe a good cup of tea needs no complicated recipe. The tea base is brewed fresh every day, the milk foam is whipped from fresh milk, and the syrup is made by our staff from yellow rock sugar. Customers can freely choose sweetness and ice, or swap milk for oat milk. A small blackboard in the shop lists the origin of the day's tea leaves and the brewing parameters, and anyone is welcome to ask.

To thank the neighbors who keep coming back, we launched a membership card: buy ten cups and get one free, and upgrade to a large cup for free during your birthday month. Members can also reserve the limited edition drink a day ahead and pick it up in store. We also partner with the bakery nearby to offer a tea-and-pastry set every Friday afternoon.

In the coming year, we plan to open a second shop in the next community and launch mini-program ordering so nobody has to queue. Wherever we open, Cha Xiaoman will keep the same standard: the origin of the tea is visible, the ingredients are clearly listed, and prices are not raised at will. Come and sit with us often.

sample_spec.terms: 冷萃乌龙=cold brew oolong,鲜果茶=fresh fruit tea,会员卡=membership card,限定饮品=limited edition drink
